query: UPDATE manifestations m SET enrichment_status = CASE WHEN m.enrichment_rerun_requested THEN 'pending'::enrichment_status WHEN m.enrichment_attempt_count >= $3 THEN 'skipped'::enrichment_status ELSE 'failed'::enrichment_status END, enrichment_attempt_count = CASE WHEN m.enrichment_rerun_requested THEN 0 ELSE m.enrichment_attempt_count END, enrichment_attempted_at = CASE WHEN m.enrichment_rerun_requested THEN NULL ELSE m.enrichment_attempted_at END, enrichment_retry_not_before = NULL, enrichment_error = CASE WHEN m.enrichment_rerun_requested THEN NULL ELSE $4 END, enrichment_failures = CASE WHEN m.enrichment_rerun_requested THEN '[]'::jsonb ELSE $5 END, enrichment_rerun_requested = FALSE FROM UNNEST($1::uuid[], $2::bigint[]) AS c(id, claim_seq) WHERE m.id = c.id AND m.enrichment_status = 'in_progress' AND m.enrichment_claim_seq = c.claim_seq
